spec.name: longitudinal-adoption-10y
spec.precision_rule: Bonferroni Student-t continuous planning and exact-binomial paired closure planning; disjoint pilot; fixed confirmation roster
spec.inferential_scope: conditional fixed-model paired-world strategy comparison; no empirical calibration
spec.history_mode: conditional-synthetic-state; organization age is not simulated prehistory
spec.calendar_scope: Gregorian weekdays; January 1 and December 25 are declared synthetic nonwork holidays
spec.tail_scope: common 90-calendar-day settlement followup; no new work/claims/votes; unfinished stocks retained

federation.listing_and_financing: context assumptions; no modelled IPO, valuation or unicorn probability

listed.listing_and_financing: context assumptions; no modelled IPO, valuation or unicorn probability

startup.listing_and_financing: context assumptions; no modelled IPO, valuation or unicorn probability

primary_endpoints.name: work_per_present_member_workday
primary_endpoints.unit: synthetic work units / actual present-member workday

primary_endpoints.name: net_resource_gain_per_present_member_workday
primary_endpoints.unit: synthetic resource units / actual present-member workday

spec.exposure_rule: actual recorded member-time; no N*days denominator; zero exposure is undefined and retained
spec.missing_rule: no world is discarded; unavailable post windows and closed/not-adopted cases remain explicit
spec.independent_unit: world ID, paired within context; years, guilds, branches and machines are not independent samples
